categories.main_business_segments: Beijing YJK Building Software Co., Ltd. primarily operates in software development and related technical services for the construction, municipal, power, subway, industrial plant, and bridge sectors. Its main products include BIM standardized software and digital comprehensive solutions covering design, construction, and management phases, with a focus on building lifecycle BIM functionalities. The company offers a range of software products such as architectural structure design, green building design, full professional BIM design and collaboration, bridge BIM and inspection software, municipal and power industry software, and construction software.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company relies on proprietary core technologies including a general BIM and digital software development platform, high-performance graphics platform, BIM data and collaboration platform, general finite element analysis core, automated building structure design system, and large language models with AI integration. These technologies enable parameterized modeling, multi-disciplinary cloud collaboration, high-efficiency 3D rendering, intelligent BIM model generation from 2D drawings, and advanced structural analysis with CPU+GPU heterogeneous computing. The company emphasizes autonomous innovation and platform openness, supporting multi-language international standards and cross-platform deployment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are architectural design institutes, real estate companies, and higher education institutions, predominantly state-owned or state-controlled enterprises. The company serves industries including residential and commercial buildings, sports venues, roads and bridges, municipal facilities, subway stations, industrial plants, petrochemical, power, and new energy sectors. Its products are widely used across China’s mainstream construction and infrastructure sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with sales distributed across Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. It has established a nationwide direct sales network supplemented by regional marketing and technical service teams. Additionally, it has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Hong Kong to facilitate international business expansion, particularly targeting Belt and Road countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing YJK operates primarily in the midstream segment of the software and information technology service supply chain, focusing on software development, technical services, and digital solutions for the construction and infrastructure industries. It provides core software products and platforms that support design, construction, and operation phases, enabling digital transformation and intelligent construction workflows.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on enhancing BIM and digital software platforms, integrating AI and large language models, and expanding product coverage in architectural structure design, green building, multi-disciplinary BIM collaboration, construction management, and bridge engineering. It aims to deepen internationalization, support domestic industrial software substitution, and build a comprehensive BIM ecosystem. The company also emphasizes talent development, open innovation, and expanding into emerging business areas aligned with national digitalization and green development strategies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software sales, technical development and service contracts, and software usage fees. The company employs a direct sales model supported by a network of agents, providing products and solutions with ongoing technical support and training services. Revenue recognition follows contract fulfillment, with software sales recognized at delivery and acceptance, and service revenues recognized over the service period or upon completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading domestic provider of BIM and industrial software solutions with strong autonomous innovation capabilities. It holds a competitive advantage through proprietary core technologies, comprehensive product portfolios, and deep integration with national industry standards. The company is recognized for its technical leadership in BIM software and digital construction solutions within China’s software and information technology service industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 133.8 million, a 17.65% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 50.78 million, worsening by 26.35%. Despite the decline, the company maintains substantial cash reserves (~RMB 724 million) and continues significant R&D investment (~RMB 79.6 million, about 59.46% of revenue). The company’s total assets stood at approximately RMB 901 million at year-end 2024. It faces seasonal revenue fluctuations with higher sales in the fourth quarter.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its fully autonomous core technology platforms, enabling flexible and independent product development without reliance on third parties. Its products offer comprehensive BIM lifecycle coverage, multi-disciplinary collaboration, international standard compliance, and integration of AI-driven intelligent modeling and design optimization. The company’s solutions support digital transformation, intelligent construction, and green building initiatives, providing customers with high-efficiency, high-quality, and innovative software tools tailored to complex engineering and infrastructure projects.
